card.writes: It seems to promote words like inevitably and risk and to suppress unless and if-not words, which fits statements of unavoidable uncertainty.
card.plain: It marks stock warning phrases saying monitoring cannot promise protection, or that nearly all antibacterials can cause C. difficile diarrhea.
